item.title: [opsec] French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle tracked via Strava activity in OPSEC failure
item.description: A French aircraft carrier was tracked in real time via a sailor’s Strava activity, exposing a persistent operational security flaw. Le Monde revealed that France’s aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle was tracked in real time through an officer’s activity on the Strava app. A sailor unknowingly shared running data from the ship, exposing its location [&#8230;]
